rule: Only coding options verified on a real car (exact brand, model, years, module address and part number, read-back confirmed) are listed in 'options'. Unknown variants are never written.
howToAdd: 1. Create a full backup in the app (Coding → Backup).
2. Change the setting with the car's own menu or a dealer tool.
3. Create a second backup and use 'Compare' to see exactly which bytes changed.
4. Share both backups; the changed DID/byte/bit becomes a verified option here after a write + read-back test on the same car.
